title: Meet Bolt, the Cutest Dog at the Airport (and He Works There!)
summary:
Have you ever seen a dog at the airport and wished you could pet it? Well, there's a dog named Bolt who works at Dallas Fort Worth International Airport in Texas. He just won the TSA's Cutest Canine Contest for 2026! That's like winning a beauty pageant, but for dogs who help keep airports safe.

Bolt is a three-year-old German shorthaired pointer. That's a medium-sized dog that loves to run and play. He's the third dog of his breed to win this contest in the last four years. That's pretty cool, right?

But Bolt isn't just cute—he has an important job. He sniffs for explosives at the airport. That means he uses his super-sensitive nose to smell things that could be dangerous. When he smells something suspicious, he tells his handler, Daphne Wang, by acting differently. Then she knows to check it out.

Bolt's handler says he's a hard worker with a big personality. "He is such a character and a hard-working little guy," she said. "He absolutely loves his job and coming to work." She also said he's always full of energy, even at home.

Even though Bolt is adorable, you can't pet him when he's working. He and his handler are busy keeping people safe. But you can see him in the 2027 TSA Canine Calendar, which you can download for free later this year. It will have pictures of Bolt and other cute dogs.

So next time you're at the airport and see a dog, remember—they might be working hard to keep you safe. And maybe they're as cute as Bolt!
why_it_matters: Next time you see a dog at the airport, remember it might be a working dog like Bolt, so it's best to admire it from a distance and let it do its job.
